before: Hybrid frame that drops to 362 grams once you pop the 8-gram cap weight out, making back-glass defense feel super easy. Its dry, medium-hard touch and centered sweet spot give you total control on slow chiquitas and fast half-volleys. Up at the net, the sandy grit bites well on drop shots, sliced volleys, and deep viboras that don't float. Because the balance stays low and the sweet spot sits in the middle, catching balls high on the face feels off-center. You'll also need a longer swing on blocks and flat smashes.
after: Hybrid frame that drops to 362 g once you pop the 8 g cap weight out, so back-glass defence feels easy. Dry, medium-hard touch and a centred sweet spot give total control on slow chiquitas and fast half-volleys. At the net, the sandy grit bites on drop shots, sliced volleys and deep víboras that don't float. Downsides: the low balance and central sweet spot make high contact feel off-centre. Blocks and flat smashes also need a longer swing.
highlights_before: total control on slow chiquitas and fast half-volleys
catching balls high on the face feels off-center
highlights_after: total control on slow chiquitas and fast half-volleys

before: The Technical Viper 2025 comes across as pure left-side power for advanced attackers who want to finish every high ball. Their ~368 g sample feels hard with controlled rather than trampoline exit, a manageable mid-size sweet spot, and surprising maneuverability for the stiffness. At the net and on flat/kick smashes it delivers heavy pace when contact is clean, while mishits stay short. They score power, smash and vibora very high, with weaker marks for lobs and note it is not for every level.
after: Pure left-side power for advanced attackers who want to finish every high ball. Their roughly 368 g sample feels hard, with a controlled exit rather than a trampoline one. The mid-size sweet spot is manageable, and it is surprisingly manoeuvrable for how stiff it is. At the net and on flat and kick smashes it hits heavy when contact is clean, while mishits stay short. Power, smash and víbora score very high and lobs get weaker marks. They note it is not for every level.
